beyond: Beyond that: the atlas — every domain in one place, a cross-domain view, a map, an address for each event and shareable cards. No date promised.

roadmap.title: The scenario engine, and two more watches
roadmap.detail: The watch is written into the code today, which is why there is only one. This turns a scenario into authored data — several decision points, branching, a source on every beat — and then adds B-59 Arkhipov, 1962 and the Norwegian rocket, 1995.

roadmap.title: A full story for every event
roadmap.detail: The twenty-one entries still marked as drafts get what the five curated ones have: a written reconstruction, a minute-by-minute, and a second research pass on the cases where historians disagree.

roadmap.title: A second domain beyond nuclear
roadmap.detail: One new risk area — autonomous systems, biosafety or critical infrastructure — with twenty to thirty documented incidents and its own published index. Scores would not be comparable across domains, and the site would say so.
